quotes.text: "The username should be the username returned from autodiscovery"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed test message calls the displayed username a result returned from autodiscovery, while its expected value remains emailUser.email. The original confirmation view is populated with username: stateData.email. This assertion therefore checks the submitted email, not a distinct returned username. Its value check and the null-config repair are separate from this misleading diagnostic wording.
title: The credentials-confirmation assertion message names the wrong username source
